title: agent-reference config
description: Desired state for the local reference source an agent can read. Lives at agent-reference.json (committed) or agent-reference.local.json (machine-specific, gitignored).

$schema.description: URL of this schema. Optional; ignored at runtime.

packages.description: npm ecosystem packages to materialize, keyed by package name.

ref.description: Commit, tag, or branch to check out, overriding automatic version resolution. Use this when a repository's tagging scheme cannot be guessed; a pinned ref always wins.

repository.description: Git remote to use when registry metadata has none or points at the wrong repo. github:owner/repo, a git URL, or file:../repo. Setting both repository and ref skips the registry entirely, which is how unpublished or private packages work.

directory.description: Package subdirectory within the repository, for monorepos where it cannot be detected.

zod.description: Schema shapes we mirror in our own validators

odd-tags.description: Pinned by hand: tags do not follow any known pattern

folders.description: Local folders that should show up as agent references, keyed by shorthand name.

oneOf.description: Path to the folder. Relative paths resolve from the project root; ~/ resolves from the home directory.

api-docs.description: Source of truth for endpoint contracts

git.description: Arbitrary git repositories to materialize, keyed by shorthand name.

oneOf.description: github:owner/repo#ref, a git URL with an optional #ref, or file:../repo#ref.

repository.description: github:owner/repo, a git URL, or file:../repo.

ref.description: Branch, tag, or commit. Defaults to the repository default branch.

allPackages.description: Track every discovered direct dependency, not just the ones listed in `packages`.

allImporters.description: Scan every workspace importer in the lockfile instead of only the current package.

registry.description: npm registry base URL. Defaults to https://registry.npmjs.org.

worktreeDir.description: Keep checkouts in this project-local directory instead of the machine-wide store.

cacheDir.description: Override the machine-wide store location for bare repositories and shared worktrees.

sets.description: Labeled lists of references: a description saying what the collection is for, with members declared inline. Member names derive from the path or repository basename. The same reference may appear in several sets.

name.description: Optional short handle for CLI selection (--set <name>). The description is the display heading either way.

description.description: What this collection is for; doubles as the heading in status output.

name.description: Explicit reference name, overriding the one derived from the path or repository basename.

oneOf.description: github:owner/repo#ref, a git URL with an optional #ref, or file:../repo#ref.

name.description: Explicit reference name, overriding the one derived from the path or repository basename.

oneOf.description: Package name; the version follows the lockfile.

examples.description: Documentation sources to read before writing docs

folders.name: api-docs
folders.description: Source of truth for endpoint contracts

packageVersion.description: "installed" to follow the active lockfile, or an exact version, semver range, or dist-tag resolved through the registry.

description.description: Free-form note explaining what this reference is for. Shown to agents in `agent-reference status`.
